pictures.scene: Guariento di Arpo, Coronation of the Virgin Altarpiece - rank on rank of gold-ground angels and saints standing in the highest heaven above the enthroned Christ, praise the LORD from the heavens, praise Him in the highest places
pictures.name: pd_guariento_kroning

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Sunrise, Yosemite Valley - the sun coming up gold through the mist between the great cliffs and burning on the river below, praise Him, O sun and moon, praise Him, all you shining stars
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_zonsopgang

pictures.scene: Jan van de Cappelle, estuary with ships - a towering bank of cloud filling almost the whole canvas above a calm wide water with sailing vessels on it, praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies
pictures.name: pd_cappelle_wateren

pictures.scene: Giovanni di Paolo, The Creation of the World - God the Father borne up by blue seraphim with His hand stretched out to the ringed disc of the created cosmos, for He gave the command and they were created
pictures.name: pd_paolo_schepping

pictures.scene: Pieter Neefs the Younger, Een kerkinterieur - the long stone piers and vaults of a great church receding into the light, built to stand, He established them forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_neefs_kerkinterieur

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, Northeaster - a heavy sea breaking white up the dark rocks with the spray thrown high, all great sea creatures and ocean depths
pictures.name: pd_homer_noordooster

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, De molen bij Wijk bij Duurstede - the great mill on the bank with its sails turning under a huge broken storm sky, lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_molen

pictures.scene: Ivan Shishkin, Mast-Tree Grove - tall sunlit pines standing straight up out of the forest floor beside a clear shallow stream, mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars
pictures.name: pd_sjisjkin_mastbos

pictures.scene: Edward Hicks, Noah's Ark - lion, bear, tiger, deer, sheep and horses gathered on the grass while the beasts file two by two up the ramp and birds wheel overhead, wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds
pictures.name: pd_hicks_ark

pictures.scene: Joris van Schooten, De aanbidding der koningen - the kings in gold-bordered brocade come down from their horses under the star with the crowd of peoples pressing in behind them, kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth
pictures.name: pd_schooten_koningen

pictures.scene: Andreas Ritzos, Icon of the Ascension of Christ - Christ lifted in the dark mandorla by two angels above the apostles and His mother, who stand with their hands raised to Him, His name alone is exalted, His splendor is above the earth and the heavens
pictures.name: pd_ritzos_hemelvaart

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD from the heavens;
praise Him in the highest places.
Praise Him, all His angels;
praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
Praise Him, O sun and moon;
praise Him, all you shining stars.
Praise Him, O highest heavens,
and you waters above the skies.
Let them praise the name of the LORD,
for He gave the command and they were created.
He established them forever and ever;
He issued a decree that will never pass away.
Praise the LORD from the earth,
all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
powerful wind fulfilling His word,
mountains and all hills,
fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all cattle,
crawling creatures and flying birds,
kings of the earth and all peoples,
princes and all rulers of the earth,
young men and maidens,
old and young together.
Let them praise the name of the LORD,
for His name alone is exalted;
His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
He has raised up a horn for His people,
the praise of all His saints,
of Israel, a people near to Him.
Hallelujah!
